verdict.rationale: The product documents its own versioning for agent presets: an effort level can be pinned to a dated release (e.g. `fast@2026-10-16.0`) so a configuration keeps working after the level moves on. The API also uses a `/v1/` path, and the docs note that legacy Sonar requests are being reformulated as Agent API requests while continuing to work. This is real but narrow versioning, and the pack contains no deprecation policy, timelines, or sunset guarantees. missing for 10: documented deprecation policy with notice periods and sunset timelines, API-wide versioning scheme and changelog, independent corroboration of version-pinning stability.
